detail.command:
printf '
=== STATUS ===
'; git status --short; printf '
=== FILES ===
'; find src -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort; printf '
=== PACKAGE ===
'; cat package.json; printf '
=== CONTRACTS ===
'; find src -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*contract*' -o -iname '*dto*' -o -iname '*type*' \) -print -exec sh -c 'echo "--- $1"; sed -n "1,240p" "$1"' _ {} \;
